method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: One-tap flip with animation
features.detail: click or tap the coin to toss it; a flip animation lands on heads or tails
features.verse_evidence: skills/coin.js: CSS 3D coin lands in a third of a second; tap the coin to flip again

features.name: Heads / tails result shown
features.detail: the side is written under the coin
features.verse_evidence: skills/coin.js shows the word under the coin

features.name: Flip counter
features.detail: a running count of flips this visit

features.name: Coin colour schemes
features.detail: choose the coin/page colour from a set of colour options
features.verse_evidence: coin maker sets the metal and faces (skills/coin.js "Make your own coin"); no one-tap page colour themes

features.name: Flip sound
features.detail: a sound as the coin lands (not confirmed by search)
features.verse_evidence: skills/coin.js "Sound on"/"Sound off", a ring made in the browser

features.name: Android app
features.detail: "Just Flip A Coin - Coin Flip" on Google Play
features.verse_evidence: no native app; /flip/ opens offline after one visit (sw.js)

features.name: No statistics beyond the count
features.detail: reviewers note there is no stats history (a lack, listed for completeness)
features.verse_evidence: Verse has more: per-visit tally plus everyone's flips (/api/tally)

verse_extra: Any real coin from 600 BC to now with its real faces
Design your own coin (metal, words, rim text, year, photos)
Share link that keeps the coin
